core_categories: Medical Device Distribution; Sales and Marketing Services; Logistics Services; Technical and Engineering Services; Clinical Education and Training
specialty_focus: Healthcare 21 is a specialized provider of outsourced sales, marketing, logistics, and technical engineering services for global medical technology and device manufacturers. They serve acute hospitals, primary care facilities, and retail pharmacies across the UK and Ireland, acting as a bridge between medtech brands and healthcare providers. They do not manufacture wearable medical devices but distribute and support a range of medical devices and life science products.
key_brands: 3M, Abena, Aerogen, Allergan, AngioDynamics, Avanos, BD, Direct Healthcare Group, Fujifilm, Raizer, Sunrise Medical, Cardinal Health, others
